artworks.title: Ornament
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornamental design featuring a mythical creature. The central figure in the design is a creature with a human upper body and stylized elements that resemble wings or fins, integrating intricate floral and scroll patterns throughout. The upper part of the design includes motifs that may resemble flowers or shells, while the lower section features symmetric decorations including two detailed insects and a vase-like shape at the bottom. The entire design showcases elaborate ornamental motifs typical of decorative or architectural art.

artworks.title: Ornament
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two elaborate vases. The drawing shows two tall ornamental vases placed next to each other, each adorned with intricate designs. The left vase features classical figures within oval frames on its upper and lower sections, surrounded by floral and scroll motifs. The right vase is also decorated with swirling floral patterns and grotesque faces, with a distinct classical motif at the top. Both vases have a symmetrical and detailed design, typical of historical decorative works.

artworks.title: Ornament
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate, symmetrical floral design with classical elements. The vertical composition features an elaborate decorative panel resembling an elongated shield shape. The centerpiece contains a medallion with a figure holding a spear and standing next to a shield, surrounded by intricate floral and foliage patterns. The design includes cherubic faces and animal motifs such as rabbits, along with scrolls and intricate engravings. This detailed ornamental artwork showcases patterns reminiscent of Renaissance design, focusing on symmetry and elaborate detailing.

artworks.title: Ornament
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate, decorative object. The artwork displays a richly detailed design with intricate patterns throughout. There is an oval medallion depicting two figures, surrounded by swirling motifs. The bottom part features a sculpted head in profile. The details emphasize a baroque style, with fine linework creating depth and texture.

artworks.title: Ornament
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an intricately designed ornament. The vertically oriented artwork features a detailed ornament with various decorative elements. At the top is an ornate crown or crest containing a house surrounded by foliage and figures resembling mythical animals, possibly lions or griffons. Below that, there is an oval frame enclosing a sun motif with an anthropomorphic face. Extending downward, two cherubic figures or putti hold a circular emblem. In the central section, there is an oval medallion with an image of a classical female figure holding branches or flowers, draped in flowing garments. The lowest portion of the ornament is capped with another figure that appears to be half-human, half-creature, possibly a variation of a satyr or another mythological being. The piece features swirling, symmetrical lines, consistent with design practices of the Renaissance or Baroque period.

artworks.title: Ornament
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a decorative panel with various motifs. The image showcases a vertically elongated panel adorned with intricate baroque designs. The top features elaborate scrollwork and a circular medallion with an eagle motif, framed by ornate scrolls and a crown-like ornament. Below is a scene with two figures, one holding a rose and the other holding a scythe. Further down is a majestic figure with a flowing beard and outstretched arms. The panel is labeled "PSALMUS CIII." At the bottom, a female figure with long flowing hair holds a mirror, surrounded by swirling floral and leaf motifs.

artworks.title: Ornament
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornamental design. The drawing depicts an elaborately detailed ornamental design featuring mythological and allegorical elements, with intricate scrollwork and human figures. In the upper part, there are seahorses and a crowned shield with clasped hands, underneath the inscription "PER PECCATUM MORS." Below this, a scene involves two entwined figures surrounded by foliage. Further down, the slender ornamental column features putti and another oval medallion with a robed figure.

artworks.title: Jewelry Ornament
artworks.description: This is a drawing of engraved decorative patterns. The drawing presents a series of intricately detailed engraved ovals and circular patterns with floral and scroll designs. Each design varies slightly in size and intricacy but maintains a symmetrical and delicate style. The drawing likely focuses on the ornate texture and complexity of the designs, intended for decorative purposes or illustrating decorative arts.

artworks.title: Bow Embellished with Flowers
artworks.description: This is an ornate lace ornament. The object resembles a large bow with a ribbon on top, featuring intricate floral and leaf patterns within its segments. Each section is detailed with various botanical motifs, and at the bottom, a hanging pear shape is visible. The ribbon is tied into a bow. The design showcases careful craftsmanship and symmetrical composition commonly seen in decorative arts.

artworks.title: Star Embellished with Flowers
artworks.description: The image shows a large star shape composed of multiple elongated triangles radiating outward from a central point. Adjacent to the central star are smaller abstract shapes with floral patterns. At the bottom of the central star is a ribbon design.

artworks.title: Pendant Embellished with Flowers
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a dagger sheath surrounded by floral patterns. The central object is a stylized sheath with motifs of flowers and vines. On either side are two vertical bands with floral decorations. The design is symmetrical with detailed floral forms and foliage. The background is plain, emphasizing the intricate details of the piece.

artworks.title: Cross Embellished with Flowers
artworks.description: The image shows a prominent cross shape in the center, adorned with intricate floral patterns and surrounded by additional abstract floral designs. The cross and the flowers together create an abstract representation reminiscent of a stylized tapestry or fabric design. In the two upper corners of the image, rectangular panels also contain intricate floral motifs, adding to the complexity and symmetry of the overall image. The swirling leaves and flowers integrated within the cross’s outline and the surrounding decorative elements evoke the familiar appearance of lush, ornamental gardens.

artworks.title: Fountain of Youth
artworks.artist: Johann Theodor de Bry after Sebald Beham
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bathhouse scene. The image features a large, ornate bathhouse with classical architectural elements like columns and frieze work. The structure is busy with people bathing and socializing in and around the pools. Outside, there is a large fountain with figures climbing and interacting with it. The background includes hills and a church. At the bottom of the drawing, there is a block of text.

artworks.title: Country Fair
artworks.artist: Johann Theodor de Bry after Sebald Beham
artworks.description: This is an etching of a village scene with various activities and gatherings happening. The central house is surrounded by people engaging in different activities. To the left, there are figures involved in games, socializing, dancing, and holding tools or weapons. In the background, there are riders on horseback, with trees and hills in the distance. To the right, there's a church with a clock tower, where a line of people is entering or leaving. Beside the church, there is a market-like scene with people engaging in trade or bartering. The scene captures the hustle and bustle of a village festival or fair, with a castle in the background.

artworks.title: The Golden Age
artworks.artist: Johann Theodor de Bry after Abraham Bloemaert after Nicolaes de Bruyn
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a pastoral scene. The artwork features a detailed, circular composition with a landscape filled with trees, animals, and figures engaging in various activities. The style resembles intricate engravings depicting golden ages in classical mythology. The central focus is a large tree surrounded by reclining figures and animals. Above the scene is a scroll of text and above that, clouds with angelic figures. The border includes decorative elements and cherub-like figures. The artwork emphasizes harmony with nature and classical themes.

artworks.title: Army Train and Death
artworks.artist: Johann Theodor de Bry after Erhard Schön

artworks.title: The Baggage Train with the Sergeant-Major
artworks.artist: Johann Theodor de Bry after Sebald Beham
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a procession of armored figures and a horse-drawn wagon. The image shows a line of individuals in period costumes and armor, carrying spears and swords, accompanied by a horse-drawn carriage laden with goods. The scene is filled with intricate details depicting various textures and lines, particularly in the clothing and the equipment they carry. The figures are arranged in a linear composition from left to right, exhibiting dynamic interactions.

artworks.title: Solomon de Bray
artworks.artist: Dirck de Bray, after Jan de Bray
artworks.description: This print shows an older man from the waist up, his body facing the left and his head turned toward us. He has light skin and strong facial features with deep-set eyes, pronounced wrinkles, curly, light-colored, shoulder-length hair, a thin mustache, and a beard in a vertical line from his mouth to his chin. He is wearing a small black cap and is dressed in a formal garment with a high white color and buttons down the front. The background is tan paper, with some shading on the left and right. Text below the portrait reads "Salomon de Bray, Schilder en Bouwmeester, tot Haerlem."

artworks.title: Self-Portrait (Edgar Degas, par lui-même)
artworks.description: This print shows a portrait of a man from the waist up. The man is slightly turned to the left, looking out at us. He has a beard and a thin mustache and is wearing a dark, wide-brimmed hat. He is dressed in a dark, textured coat. The background is plain beige paper, with a section of dark shadow around the man’s waist.

artworks.title: The Engraver Joseph Tourny (Le graveur Joseph Tourny)
artworks.description: This print shows a portrait of an individual seen from the waist up, turned slightly towards the left, looking at us with their arms resting on a ledge. They have a broad forehead, a long nose, deep-set eyes, and thin lips in a neutral expression. Their short hair is mostly obscured by a cap. They wear a loose garment with a high collar, depicted with cross-hatched lines. The background is filled with horizontal and diagonal lines, suggesting a wall or curtain on the left. Below this central print is a smaller design that appears to show a profile sketch of another person wearing a dark cap. This smaller portrait is oriented horizontally.

artworks.title: The Actress Ellen Andrée
artworks.description: The image depicts a full-body sketch of a person facing slightly to the side, looking to the left. The facial features are not detailed, as the face is turned away. The person wears a wide-brimmed hat, a long skirt with patterns, and a dark coat. One hand appears to be in a pocket, while the other is unclear. The background is plain with a lightly textured surface.

artworks.title: Dancers in the Wings
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, and drypoint on chine-like laid paper
artworks.description: The image consists of curved and flowing lines creating an abstract composition. Some lines and forms resemble figures of people, with outlines and postures suggesting shapes akin to individuals. Toward the upper right section, a round shape emerges through the textured background. The texture combines fine dots and smooth patches, evoking a sense of depth.

artworks.title: On Stage I
artworks.medium: soft-ground etching and drypoint on wove paper
artworks.description: We look up at a stage from an orchestra pit or the first row of seats in a theater in this horizontal etching and drypoint print. The forms of people along the bottom edge of the scene, the two ballerinas on stage, and the backdrop behind them are scratched and scrawled in, sometimes heavily, creating areas of inky black. Closest to us and at the bottom center of the paper, the tall neck of an upright bass rests on the shoulder of a bearded man, who we only see from the moustache up. To our left, the hair, forehead, and noses of two more heads face him, and another, to our right, faces away. The instrument’s scrolling headstock reaches halfway up the composition, and it mostly obscures the dancers, who wear light-colored bodices and knee-length tutus. The background is almost filled with dark, squiggly lines. The print is signed in the bottom right corner, “Degas.”

artworks.title: Dancers in the Wings
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, and drypoint on wove paper
artworks.description: Four women are depicted from the waist up against a dark, textured background. Two women face each other while the other two appear to be looking down. The women have distinct facial features and varying hairstyles. They are dressed in off-the-shoulder garments. The background resembles a cave or grotto with two circular lights illuminating the scene. There are no visible jewelry or objects in the women's hands, and the artist's signature is visible in the bottom right corner.
